native_windows.evidence_scope: Tray preview and native menu actions use the exact production Windows Forms context and Node control receiver with synthetic work under isolated CP949 and UTF-8 consoles. The packaged application regressions use real bundled Node, DPAPI and isolated records. No owner install, account, production startup entry or live message is changed.
native_windows.probe_version: Final baseline and upgrade variants both exercise duplicate-background reopening. All artifact entries match final runtime bytes.

validation.npm_ci_ignore_scripts: passed; one pre-existing moderate Ajv advisory recorded separately
validation.native_windows_rust: Unchanged crates, schemas, Cargo and exact native broker: preceding Windows workspace/process results reused; packaged native broker read/traversal tests passed again.
boundary_cases: Slow cleanup closes admission before its first await; active inference becomes interrupted, observed usage remains, queued work resumes once after reopen.
Slow HTTP settings body and asynchronous startup admission cannot mutate after stopping.
New Telegram polling stops without acknowledging an unaccepted update; pending account inspection cannot persist credentials.
Unsent alert stays queued; observed receipt stays sent; ambiguous send stays unknown and is not replayed.
Shutdown after browser input preserves its actual value and uncertain verification across restart.
Parent pipe accepts only bounded fixed commands, coalesces pending opens, and gives EOF priority over a pending open.

The first open works with a .NET UTF-8 BOM, including every split boundary; partial, repeated and misplaced preambles cannot admit a command. Native first-command bytes were checked in CP949 and UTF-8 processes.

retained_failures.stage: first new Telegram shutdown fixture run
retained_failures.result: Four fixture failures: zero-count delivery keys are absent rather than numeric zero; cleanup attempted to answer the same HTTP response twice, leaving one synthetic test process alive.
retained_failures.followup: Corrected assertions and one-shot fixture reply; stopped only the known test process; unforced focused 77-test suite and full 1099-test suite passed. No product expectation was weakened.

retained_failures.result: Valid P2: .NET redirected stdin can emit a UTF-8 BOM, causing the first tray open to be discarded. The initial all-.NET fixture decoded it before checking the command and missed the product receiver failure.
retained_failures.followup: The Node receiver accepts exactly one initial UTF-8 preamble. The native fixture now connects the real Windows Forms context to the production Node receiver, checks actual bytes in CP949 and UTF-8, and verifies first click plus EOF stop. Raw BaseStream writes were also observed to retain the automatic preamble, so a sender-only raw write was not used.

remaining_limits: Same-machine native proof; no clean second Windows device, physical phone or actual Windows login acceptance.
Explicit stop preserves unstarted requests for next launch; it does not cancel all saved work or revoke accounts.
External changes are not rolled back by shutdown. Unknown sends/actions remain unknown.
Unsigned distribution, backup/restore and broad assistant acceptance remain separate release gates.
